title: What You Buy Is a Climate Decision Too
assessmentMethod: Private reflective journal entry, not scored

body.en: Every purchase carries a footprint before it even reaches you — how it was made, transported, and packaged. That doesn't mean every decision needs to be perfect, but small, consistent shifts (buying local produce, choosing durable goods over disposable ones, cutting food waste) add up more than people expect, especially across a whole household or community over a year. Think about your own spending over the past week. What's one purchase you'd reconsider if you thought about its full footprint, not just its price?
